# EdgeMenuManager

> **File:** `services/ui/EdgeMenuManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Which edge menus (EdgeMenusConfig) are open and which are pinned. The menus themselves (shell/EdgeMenus) follow this and report back when they close on their own. Kept across QML reloads, so a reload doesn't close an integrated menu and reflow the windows. Pins are also saved to $XDG_STATE_HOME/axiom/ui/edgemenus.json, and a pinned menu opens again when qs starts. Also the layouts editor's working copy of EdgeMenus (the pinned Layouts overlay page), as BarManager is the bar editor's: edits show live on the running menus (ConfigManager.previews) until saved or reset, and `previewing` holds one menu open to try them on. axiom ipc edgeMenu toggle <id>

### Properties

- `openMenus` (readonly var): { id: true } for each open / pinned menu
- `pinnedMenus` (readonly var)
- `anchors` (var): What opened each menu (a bar button), which keeps a floating menu open while hovered, as a bar popout's anchor does.
- `claimKinds` (var): How each open menu ranks in PopoutManager (its PopoutClaim's kind): "bar" when a widget's PopoutAnchor opened it as that widget's popout, else "menu".
- `zones` (var): Space open integrated menus reserve, by "<screen>:<edge>" (edge "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"), for surfaces that place themselves against the perpendicular edges (BarPopouts)
- `frames` (readonly var): Where each running menu's modules can sit on its screen, by id, as the menu reports it (IntegratedEdgeMenu, FloatingEdgeMenu), for the layouts editor.
- `showingOthers` (readonly bool): The editor draws the other menus on the selected one's screen
- `revealing` (var): Menus opened for something outside them (the launcher, IPC) that take the cursor: the menu warps it into its box once shown (CompositorManager.warpCursorToLayer), and doesn't close on leave until it …
- `localMenus` (readonly alias)
- `savedMenus` (readonly alias)
- `isDirty` (readonly alias)
- `selectedMenuIndex` (int)
- `layout` (GridEditor): The selected menu's modules (see GridEditor)
- `previewing` (readonly string): The menu the editor holds open to try edits on ("" for none).
- `previewParent` (readonly string)
- `problems` (readonly var): Why the draft can't be saved as is (empty = savable)

### Signals

- `engageRequested(string id)`: Asked for while already open (a keybind, a bar Button, IPC): its host takes it as engaged (EdgePopout.engage), so a pinned one ranks as a menu again and comes forward over what covered it (PopoutMana…

### Functions

- `setZone(screenName, edge, size)`
- `zoneOn(screenName, edge)`
- `reservedOn(screen, location)`: Where windows start on a screen edge (a Bar.Location), in px from it, integrated menus included: what surfaces inside the reserved space (floating menus, docks) are placed from (BarManager.reservedOn)
- `frameLineOn(screen, location)`: The inner side of what's on a screen edge, in px from it, integrated menus included: what a surface held off an edge keeps its gaps from (BarManager.frameLine, BarManager.detachedGaps)
- `cornerLineOn(screen, location)`: Where the border frame's rounded inner corner lies from a screen edge, integrated menus included (BarManager.cornerLine)
- `heldInset(screen, location, gap)`: How far past where windows start on a screen edge (a Bar.Location; reservedOn) a surface held `gap` off its frame line (frameLineOn) is: where a held box goes, in from its window's edge there
- `setFrame(id, frame)`
- `clearFrame(id, screenName)`
- `frameOf(menu)`: A menu's frame (see `frames`): its running one's, else (a disabled menu, or one not yet reported) its padding all round
- `placementOf(menu, bounds)`: Where a menu's modules sit on its screen, in px (GridPlacement.menuPlacement, plus its `screen`), or null without a screen.
- `screenRectsOf(menu, index)`: A menu as it sits on its screen, in screen px (GridPlacement.menuOnScreen), with its `name`.
- `screenBoxOf(menu)`: A menu's screen around its grid, in grid units from its origin (GridPlacement.screenBox), for the layouts editor; null without one
- `othersOn(index)`: The draft's other enabled menus on the screen of the one at `index`, as they sit on it (screenRectsOf)

- `centreSelected()`

- `goToReference(ref)`: Goes to where a reference is: the bar editor on its widget, the keybind editor on its bind (as links: the navigator offers the way back), or the menu holding the Submenu module
- `isSaved(menu)`: Whether `menu` is saved under its id: bar buttons and keybinds are saved by other editors, so they may only point at a saved menu
- `addBarButton(barIndex, zone)`: Adds a Button that toggles the selected menu to bar `barIndex`'s `zone`, in the bar editor's draft (saved from there or with Save all), then opens the bar editor on that bar
